summary: The local deepseek_copilot_cli adapter (official GitHub Copilot CLI in BYOK mode against DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible API) is implemented, wired, and tested. The one bounded no-product-mutation LIVE canary through the real MCP launcher requires a real DeepSeek API key on the coordinator host; none is provisioned (measured: credential_present=false, blocker_reason=credential_file_absent), so the live canary is reported as BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL with an exact replay plan rather than faked to PASS. Every independent implementation, security, and regression gate passes now.

copilot_byok_contract_verified_from_cli_.source: copilot --help and copilot help providers (installed CLI, offline)
copilot_byok_contract_verified_from_cli_.activation: COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL activates BYOK; GitHub auth not required
copilot_byok_contract_verified_from_cli_.not_passed_reason: Copilot permissions stay subordinate to the outer Landlock/bubblewrap filesystem sandbox.

secret_non_leakage_invariants: api_key never in argv (only COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY as --secret-env-vars value)
api_key never in task cards, process_events.jsonl, audit log, dashboard payload, or readiness output
api_key never read from os.environ into the sanitized env (passed explicitly by the launcher)
credential file is 0600, non-symlink, owner-only, outside the repo (never Git-tracked)
blocked_credential_live_replay_plan: geoai-task-deepseek-credential set   # host, outside repo, 0600, getpass
Start MCP server with AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 and AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1
aiworkhub_agent_launch_task(task_id=<pending deepseek canary card>, runner=deepseek_*, topic=task_mcp, adapter_id=deepseek_copilot_cli, model=deepseek-v4-pro)
aiworkhub_agent_collect_result(request_id) until review_ready; return the task to Codex review
Assert: no product source mutated, only allowed_writes touched, shell=false, exact claim->review lifecycle
